name: tsid
description: Time-Sorted Unique Identifier generator for DuckDB. 32-character hex strings that sort chronologically by plain string comparison while remaining unique under bulk generation. Stable surrogate keys, audit-log primaries, and time-range pagination keys.

cta.title: Sortable Unique IDs in SQL
cta.description: Install TSID for time-sortable unique identifiers — chronological by string compare, unique by construction, recoverable timestamps. Drop-in replacement for UUIDv4 when ordering matters.
